title: Admin compare-prompts route is nested under a duplicated hub segment
reasoning: This URLconf is the feature entrypoint for the `/hub/` include, but the compare-prompts endpoint also hard-codes `hub/` inside the included URL pattern. That makes the effective route `/hub/hub/reading/<reading_id>/compare-prompts/` instead of the natural `/hub/reading/<reading_id>/compare-prompts/`, which can break clients or templates that construct the latter path from the feature prefix and endpoint path.
recommendation: Remove the redundant `hub/` prefix from this pattern so the included URLconf contributes `reading/<int:reading_id>/compare-prompts/` under the existing `/hub/` mount, or move this endpoint to a URLconf that is not mounted under `/hub/`.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover admin feast icon routes via `reverse()` and several API/view behaviors, but none exercise `hub_reading_compare_prompts` or assert the concrete URL generated for it.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a URL resolving/reversing test for `hub_reading_compare_prompts` that asserts it resolves at `/hub/reading/<id>/compare-prompts/` and not `/hub/hub/reading/<id>/compare-prompts/`.
minimumFixScope: Edit only the compare-prompts `path()` declaration in `hub/urls.py` and add a focused URL regression test.
